reasoning_content: Node 22 has already been downloaded. Bun's latest version is v1.4.3. I'll extract Node, install it to /usr/local, and download the Bun binary.

action.command: cd /tmp && tar -xf node.tar.xz && cp -r node-v22.23.3-linux-x64/* /usr/local/ && rm -rf node-v22.23.3-linux-x64 node.tar.xz && node --version && npm --version
